about: How things are made (doc 35). in/out/by: item ids to counts (fractions are shares of one unit; @fuel, @dye and @gem stand for any item tagged that way). skill: minimum trade skill. seconds: work at the station. wait: days the goods then sit (tanning, ageing, fermenting). helper: needs a second wolf. tool: an item the station must have.

recipes.note: Brine from the sea or a salt spring is free at the pan.
